name: Fathers Who Leave Their Children
overview: Scripture acknowledges the painful reality of fathers and mothers forsaking their children, yet it assures that the LORD Himself will gather and uphold those who are abandoned, as seen in Psalms 27:10. The psalmist also highlights the tragic consequences of turning away from God, including the scattering of offspring among nations and the sacrifice of children to false gods (Psalms 106:27, 37). Despite human failings, God’s intimate involvement in our formation from the womb (Psalms 139:13) contrasts with the brokenness within families, where even close kin can become adversaries (Matthew 10:36). This teaches believers to trust in God's faithful care when earthly fathers fail.
